source: Several considerations per input row of the build-spec pattern table
description: Measures whether one ordered three-level Score (different / review / same) plus field-level Nouls can separate duplicate records from distinct ones on candidate pairs whose surface similarity is deliberately misleading. Every case is decidable from the state alone: matching policy, authoritative identifier, and any corporate or clinical relationship needed for the judgment are written into the state, so no case depends on outside world knowledge. Gold Score levels are 2 for duplicates, 0 for distinct records, and 1 where the state's own policy says the pair is a review case. Tolerance follows the runner in scripts/unridden/run_usecase_suites.py, which grades the most probable Score level: tolerance 0 means that level must equal the gold level and is used on the poles, tolerance 1 is used on the middle band and on pole cases whose policy makes one adjacent level defensible, because the API claims an ordered distribution, not a calibrated one. Field Nouls are graded at 0.5 with no tolerance; a field Noul is gold false whenever the two records genuinely disagree on that field or one record leaves it blank, including in pairs whose overall gold is same. Suggested metrics: exact accuracy on levels 0 and 2, band accuracy on level 1, field-level Noul accuracy at 0.5, Choice accuracy, top-1 ranking accuracy, and the merge-error rate over the recorded fractional score_value (gold level 0 but Score expectation above 1.5), which is the metric an operator gates on. This suite does not measure calibration, blocking or candidate generation, throughput, or any ability to normalize, transform, or compute over field values; the model only selects among supplied labels.
